name: veterinary_clinic_system_022_ar_aging_report
instruction: Build the month-end accounts-receivable aging and owner-balance reconciliation pack (verify the standard 0-30 / 31-60 / 61-90 / 90+ day aging buckets if needed). Do not modify any source collection. (1) In veterinary_clinic_system_billing_invoices, consider only invoices with status 'sent' or 'overdue' and unpaid balance (total_amount - amount_paid) > 0. Age each such invoice in whole days from dp(issued_date) to the episode date; bucket the unpaid balance into the four AR aging buckets. (2) Push one ops_reports row: report='ar_aging', batch_code, bucket_0_30, bucket_31_60, bucket_61_90, bucket_90_plus (all dollars, rounded to 2 decimals), invoice_count. (3) Push one ops_reports row per location (3 total): report='ar_aging_by_location', batch_code, location_id, location_name, the same four bucket fields, invoice_count, open_total. Include all three locations, even if zero. (4) For every owner, compute ledger_open_ar = sum of unpaid 'sent'/'overdue' invoices for that owner. Compare to owners.balance. Push one ops_reports row: report='ar_reconciliation_summary', batch_code, total_owners_checked (int), discrepancies_found (int), total_open_ar (dollars), total_owner_balance (dollars, sum of all owner balances). Do not change any owner balance. (5) Append one audit_log row: action='AR_AGING_CLOSE', actor='system', actor_role='system', target_collection='ops_reports', target_id=<batch_code>, details summarizing the open invoice count, total open AR, and discrepancy count, occurred_at the episode timestamp. The pack must be idempotent: a re-run must overwrite the same batch's ops_reports rows and not create duplicate audit rows.

success_criteria.summary: No source collections modified (canary-checked). Recompute from live billing_invoices and owners: ar_aging row with correct bucket totals and invoice_count; exactly 3 ar_aging_by_location rows (one per location) with correct bucket/invoice/open totals; ar_reconciliation_summary with total_owners_checked=220, discrepancies_found, total_open_ar, and total_owner_balance. One AR_AGING_CLOSE audit row per batch. Every aggregate (bucket totals, per-owner open AR, total open AR, owner balance totals) computed two ways (raw-row Python and SQL aggregate) and agrees. Draft and paid invoices are excluded from open AR.

checks.collections: all seeded collections outside the declared blast_radius

checks.expect: Exactly 1 ar_aging row, 3 ar_aging_by_location rows, and 1 ar_reconciliation_summary row for this batch with all fields matching the re-derived aggregates.
AR bucket totals, invoice count, per-location open totals, and per-owner open AR all agree between a raw-row Python filter and an independent SQL aggregate query.

hazards: Tiny open AR in a 260-row ledger: only ids 1 (INV-1001, issued 2026-07-31, unpaid $523) and 2 (INV-1002, issued 2026-08-30, unpaid $214) are 'sent' and have unpaid balances. A solution that ages paid or draft invoices produces wrong totals.
Draft decoy: id 3 (INV-1003, status 'draft', issued 2026-09-02, unpaid $546) has a positive unpaid balance but is explicitly excluded because AR aging uses only 'sent' or 'overdue'.

Jitter-sensitive bucket boundaries: at 2026-09-30, invoice 1 (age 61 days) lands in 61-90 and invoice 2 (age 31 days) lands in 31-60; at 2026-09-27, invoice 1 is 58 days (31-60) and invoice 2 is 28 days (0-30); at 2026-10-03, invoice 1 is 64 days (61-90) and invoice 2 is 34 days (31-60). Hardcoded buckets fail.

Owner balance / ledger drift: the seed snapshot has 220 owners; 58 of them have an owner.balance that does not equal their open AR from 'sent'/'overdue' invoices. The breakdown is 55 owners with positive balance and zero open AR, 1 owner (id 1) with a smaller positive balance than their open AR, 1 owner (id 2) with zero balance but open AR, and 1 owner (id 21) with a negative balance. The task must report, not fix, these discrepancies.
Per-episode nonce and batch code: every report and audit row must carry the live batch_code from ops_meta; stale hardcoded batch codes fail.

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Fuses the classic AR aging report with an owner-balance reconciliation that deliberately does not modify owners, requiring the agent to read 6+ collections and verify every aggregate via dual SQL/API paths. The tiny open-AR set in a 260-row ledger and the large owner-balance drift are real red herrings from the 10x seed.
